verdict.rationale: Pilot's bookkeeping service does automate transaction classification via bank/tool integrations and offers 'Instant AI answers about past transactions,' and a customer report confirms transactions are auto-classified from integrations, but the reconciliation and month-end close is explicitly performed by a human dedicated bookkeeping team, not an autonomous agent, and there's no documented exception-flagging or close-prep-for-review workflow driven by AI. Missing for 10: evidence of an actual AI agent (not human staff) executing matching, flagging exceptions, and preparing a close package for review.
